Title: No confirmation dialog on transaction deletion
Description: Clicking the trash icon immediately and irreversibly deletes the transaction from Firestore without confirmation modal or undo toast.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Go to /app/transactions. 2. Click trash icon next to any transaction. 3. Transaction disappears immediately with no warning.
Suggested Remediation: Add a confirmation dialog modal or window.confirm() check before executing deleteTransaction().

Title: AI Advisor advertised as Gemini AI but runs client-side pattern matching on Web
Description: The welcome greeting states 'I am your DrvLife Gemini AI Financial Advisor', but the implementation is a client-side switch/heuristic function (unlike the Android app which uses the Gemini SDK).
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open /app/advisor. 2. Observe welcome message claiming Gemini AI. 3. Ask arbitrary financial questions not matching 'summar', 'top', or 'save'. 4. Receives generic fallback template.
Suggested Remediation: Either connect Web Advisor to Gemini API via Cloud Functions/API proxy or update label to 'DrvLife Financial Telemetry Advisor'.

Title: Contact form submission is simulated with setTimeout and does not persist
Description: Submitting the contact form shows a success banner after 1.2 seconds, but inquiries are never saved to Firestore or dispatched to an email API.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Navigate to /contact. 2. Fill in valid name, email, subject, message. 3. Click Submit. 4. Check network tab and Firestore; zero network requests or database writes occur.
Suggested Remediation: Connect ContactForm to a Firestore 'support_inquiries' collection or an email gateway (e.g., EmailJS or Firebase Extension).

Title: Lack of declarative ProtectedRoute wrapper causes momentary flash before useEffect redirect
Description: Private routes (/app/*) are not guarded at the Route element level. Unauthenticated users visiting /app/dashboard load the component, triggering auth loading state before useEffect redirects to /login.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open incognito window. 2. Navigate directly to https://liferece.surge.sh/app/dashboard. 3. Observe spinner with 'Syncing with Cloud Firestore...' before redirecting to /login.
Suggested Remediation: Wrap all /app/* routes inside a dedicated <ProtectedRoute> component that checks auth state before rendering children.

Title: Monolithic single JavaScript bundle (>1 MB uncompressed) due to absence of code-splitting
Description: All 14 pages and components are statically imported into App.tsx. Vite build produces a single 1,019.50 kB JS bundle (dist/assets/index-DZB3cAKn.js), triggering Vite warning.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Run 'npm run build'. 2. Observe Vite reporter warning: 'Some chunks are larger than 500 kB after minification'.
Suggested Remediation: Refactor App.tsx route imports to use React.lazy() and Suspense for all /app/* and marketing pages.

Title: Object URLs created by URL.createObjectURL are never revoked on modal close
Description: When viewing a receipt, getLocalReceipt creates an object URL from Blob. Closing the modal sets receiptUrl to null without calling URL.revokeObjectURL(), causing gradual memory retention.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open /app/transactions. 2. Open and close receipt viewer modal repeatedly for 20 receipts. 3. Object URLs remain in browser memory.
Suggested Remediation: Call URL.revokeObjectURL(receiptUrl) in the modal close handler.

Title: Deleting all transactions causes seed transactions to reappear on next snapshot
Description: When snapshot.empty is true, firestoreService falls back to getStoredTransactions(), which returns 4 default seed transactions (Swiggy, Salary, Uber, Bills) if local store is empty.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Log in to web app. 2. Delete all transactions. 3. If local cache is cleared or refreshed on an empty Firestore, seed transactions reappear in UI.
Suggested Remediation: Distinguish between an uninitialized account vs an intentionally empty ledger using an initialized flag.

Title: Open Graph and Twitter meta tags reference non-existent domain 'https://drvlife.app/'
Description: index.html defines og:url and twitter:url as 'https://drvlife.app/', while the live deployed website domain is 'https://liferece.surge.sh/'.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Inspect source of index.html. 2. Check meta property='og:url'. 3. Value is 'https://drvlife.app/'.
Suggested Remediation: Update og:url and twitter:url in index.html to match the canonical live domain https://liferece.surge.sh/.

Title: Dead CSS boilerplate and unused SVG starter assets bundled in source tree
Description: App.css contains 165 lines of default Vite counter and hero CSS rules not used anywhere in the app. src/assets contains react.svg, vite.svg, hero.png which are unreferenced.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Search codebase for '.counter', '#next-steps', 'react.svg'. 2. Zero references found in application JSX.
Suggested Remediation: Purge unused rules from App.css and delete unreferenced starter assets from src/assets.

Title: Multiple redundant duplicate folders (source_code, components, etc.) create maintenance hazard
Description: 02_WEBSITE contains 7 redundant duplicate directories (source_code, components, api_integration, firebase_integration, configuration, deployment, public_assets) containing 90+ redundant duplicate files.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Inspect 02_WEBSITE root. 2. Observe duplicate folders alongside active src/ and public/.
Suggested Remediation: Remove redundant folders or document them strictly as legacy snapshots so developers edit only src/.

Title: Impure new Date() called directly during component render
Description: Calling new Date() directly inside component body triggers React compiler purity warning (oxlint react/purity), preventing optimal component memoization.
Reproduction Steps: 1. Run 'npm run lint'. 2. Observe 6 react(purity) warnings for new Date() calls.
Suggested Remediation: Wrap Date derivations in useMemo() or calculate during state initialization.
